spec.title: Stored scores versus deterministic recomputation
spec.question: Does every stored score equal what the current deterministic scorer computes from the stored land cover?
spec.hypothesis: Every stored score equals computeAbsorptionScore(stored land cover) within 0.05 points.
spec.split: None: an audit of every row.
metrics: rows whose score band would change
limitations: Checks storage against code, not either against nature.

inputs.source: Mannahatta public scan feed (Supabase `analyses`, public read policy)
